title: security: rbac v2 - fix KMS region pinning audit logging + validation
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: RBAC v2 introduced KMS region pinning metadata that should be enforced and audited. During a recent compliance review and an incident (SUP-1245) we discovered gaps: (1) policy validation accepted malformed 'kms_region' constraints, (2) audit logs did not surface the effective KMS region for policy changes, and (3) the migration tool silently skipped malformed entries. This PR fixes validation, enhances audit logging, and adds migration safety checks. Summary of changes: improved policy schema validation for KMS region pinning; surfaced effective KMS region in audit events for policy create/update/delete; added a strict migration mode with a dry-run flag and detailed reporting; unit + integration tests for edge cases; docs and release notes. Migration notes: running the migration with --strict will fail on invalid entries and emit a CSV of offending rows; --dry-run shows what would change. Backwards compatibility: validation is additive (rejects malformed constraints) and migration provides a safe remediation path. Related: ENG-4321 (policy residency), SEC-108 (audit requirements).
commits_summary: feat(rbac): add stricter kms_region validation; fix(audit): include effective_kms_region in policy audit events; chore(migration): add dry-run + strict mode and CSV report; test(rbac): add unit/integration tests for region pinning; docs: update RBAC v2 KMS region pinning guide
review_comments: Devon Li: Can you add unit tests for the international region formats (e.g. eu-west-1, asia-southeast1) and a negative test for malformed region tokens?
Ava Martinez (author): Added parametrized unit tests covering common cloud region formats and an explicit negative case for malformed tokens. See tests/rbac/kms_region_test.go
Priya Rao: Audit events should include both requested_kms_region and effective_kms_region to help debug policy overrides. Can we include both?
Ava Martinez (author): Included requested_kms_region in the event payload and kept effective_kms_region. Updated audit schema migration code and docs.
Marcus Nguyen: migration tool needs a safe default for --strict when running unattended. Suggest exiting non-zero and emitting a report file.
Ava Martinez (author): migration now exits 1 on strict validation failures and writes report to ./rbac_migration_report.csv when issues found. Documented the behavior in the migration help text.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (rbac migration e2e in test cluster)
merge_outcome: Merged by Priya Rao via squash on 2024-11-20. Commit message consolidated: 'security(rbac): enforce kms_region validation, surface kms region in audit logs, add migration strict/dry-run'.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning validation in RBAC v2; audit logs now include requested_kms_region and effective_kms_region for policy changes; migration tool adds --dry-run and --strict modes with CSV reporting. Backwards-incompatible behavior: malformed kms_region constraints will now be rejected; run the migration in dry-run mode to identify offenders before enabling strict enforcement.
